note: The rung-3 panel: six slots held by five models, identical on every credited submission. Transcribed from the paper (Figure 5a and Appendix C.4). The per-slot roster is static configuration, not a run-derived quantity — the released score table records how many slots failed to break a submission, not which ones, so a slot's own totals cannot be recomputed from it. What can be checked, and is checked at build time, is that the roster closes against the release: the breaks recorded here plus the survivals in the score table plus the one round that returned no verdict account for every paid round.
